# Packworkz — full reference

> Managed packaging platform in India: custom packaging, contract-manufacturer matching (Packworkz Make), packaging machinery and scrap recycling. All prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and exclude GST unless stated. Website: https://packworkz.com

## Packworkz Make — contract and private-label manufacturers

Brands describe what they want to make; Packworkz ranks manufacturers by capability fit and introduces them directly. Direct Connect is free with 0% commission from either side. Launch Desk costs ₹14,999 one-time: three shortlisted factories, comparable quotes, samples and packaging planning. Manufacturers list free; the Verified badge (₹4,999 one-time) adds a video factory walkthrough and capacity review. Profiles marked Unclaimed are compiled from each manufacturer's own website and are not audited by Packworkz.

## Packworkz Machinery

- **Hand Impulse Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Press the arm down and a timed pulse heats the element, sealing the pouch mouth without keeping the bar hot between seals. Output: Manual, one seal per press. Best for: First-time and low-volume sealing of pouches and poly bags. Typical price ₹3,000–₹15,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Horizontal Continuous Band Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Moves filled pouches through heated bands for repeatable sealing without stopping between packs. Output: Continuous conveyor sealing. Best for: Dry, lightweight pouches that can lie flat while sealing. Typical price ₹8,450–₹20,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Vertical Continuous Band Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Supports the filled pack vertically while it passes through a controlled continuous seal. Output: Upright conveyor sealing. Best for: Liquids, powders and products that must remain upright. Typical price ₹30,000–₹50,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Induction Cap Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Bonds a foil liner to a compatible bottle or jar neck for leak resistance and tamper evidence. Output: Handheld to conveyor operation. Best for: Oils, sauces, supplements, cosmetics and other capped containers. Typical price ₹6,600–₹1,61,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Floor-standing External Vacuum Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Draws air out of the pouch through a nozzle, then heat-seals it on a clamped sealing bar. Output: Semi-automatic nozzle vacuum and seal. Best for: Rice, grains, coffee, dry fruits and larger food bags that will not fit a chamber. Typical price ₹43,500–₹2,20,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Cup & Tray Sealing Machine** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Heat-seals compatible lidding film to preformed cups and trays for a clean, tamper-evident closure. Output: Semi-automatic cup sealing. Best for: Yoghurt, beverages, dips, ready food and portion packs. Typical price ₹38,000–₹1,50,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Powder & Granule Filler** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Measures a set dose into a pouch, jar or container before it moves to the sealing step. Output: Small batches to semi-automatic lines. Best for: Spices, powders, tea, coffee, grains and free-flowing products. Typical price ₹21,000–₹1,70,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Pneumatic Paste Filler** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Uses a piston to meter repeatable doses of thicker products into jars, bottles or suitable pouches. Output: 10–1,000 ml semi-automatic filling. Best for: Sauces, spreads, creams, gels and viscous products. Typical price ₹34,700–₹1,50,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Semi-automatic Tube Filler & Sealer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Fills each tube from a heated or plain hopper, then seals and trims the open end on the same rotary table. Output: Rotary table, operator-loaded tubes. Best for: Creams, gels, ointments, toothpaste and cosmetic tubes. Typical price ₹1,90,000–₹5,00,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Double-head Liquid Filler** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Meters low to medium-viscosity liquids into bottles, jars and compatible pouches. Output: One or two-nozzle filling. Best for: Oils, syrups, beverages, shampoos and sanitisers. Typical price ₹56,000–₹4,00,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Handheld Batch & Date Coder** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Prints variable production information on compatible film, paper, board or labels. Output: Handheld and compact-line coding. Best for: MRP, batch, packed-on and expiry details on packs and cartons. Typical price ₹7,999–₹35,600 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Inline Batch Coding Printer** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Adds variable data as packs move down a conveyor, reducing manual handling at higher volumes. Output: Continuous conveyor coding. Best for: Growing lines printing MRP, lot, date and QR information. Typical price ₹15,500–₹1,25,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Semi-automatic Flat Surface Labeller** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Peels a pressure-sensitive label from the roll and presses it flat onto the pack for consistent placement. Output: Pedal-operated, one pack at a time. Best for: Flat faces of pouches, cartons, tins and flat bottles. Typical price ₹49,000–₹1,50,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Semi-automatic ROPP Capper** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Rolls and seals compatible metal caps onto filled bottles for a consistent closure. Output: Single-head bottle capping. Best for: Glass and rigid bottles using aluminium ROPP caps. Typical price ₹37,000–₹88,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Automatic VFFS Pouch Line** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Forms a pouch from printed rollstock, doses the product and seals it in one production cycle. Output: Automatic form, fill and seal. Best for: Higher-volume powders, grains, pulses, snacks and compatible liquid products. Typical price ₹1,70,000–₹18,00,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Horizontal Flow-wrap Machine** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Feeds individual products through printed rollstock, forms a pillow pack and seals it continuously. Output: Automatic pillow-pack wrapping. Best for: Bars, bakery, soap, produce and regular solid products. Typical price ₹5,90,000–₹12,00,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Shrink-wrapping Line** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Wraps grouped products in shrink film and passes them through a controlled heat tunnel. Output: Bundling and secondary wrapping. Best for: Bottle multipacks, cartons and transit bundles. Typical price ₹2,50,000–₹4,50,000 (guidance; final quote varies).
- **Pallet Stretch Wrapper** — https://packworkz.com/machinery. Applies controlled stretch film around a completed pallet before storage or freight. Output: Stable pallet loads for dispatch. Best for: Factories and warehouses shipping repeat pallet loads. Typical price ₹50,000–₹4,00,000 (guidance; final quote varies).

## Frequently asked questions

### https://packworkz.com/samples

**Are these printed with my branding?**
The kit contains representative production samples and material swatches. Once you shortlist a format, we can scope a custom branded prototype separately.

**How many samples will I receive?**
Every kit contains at least 25 pieces. Most contain 35–50+ samples depending on current format and material availability.

**How much is shipping?**
Shipping is a flat ₹100 across India. The kit is ₹299, so your checkout total is ₹399.

**Can I request a specific category?**
Yes. Add your preference in the order note and we will use it while curating the kit, subject to sample availability.

### https://packworkz.com/machinery

**Who builds and services the machines?**
Every machine comes from a vetted Indian manufacturing partner who handles installation, operator training, warranty and after-sales service. We help you shortlist, compare and buy the right model — and set up the packaging it runs.

**Are the prices final?**
No — the ranges are typical market prices for guidance. Your quote depends on speed, fill range, material contact parts, add-ons like nitrogen flushing or coding, freight and installation.

**Can I see the machine working before buying?**
Yes. We arrange a video demo with your product and pack wherever possible, and a factory visit for larger lines.

**Do you supply packaging that runs on the machine?**
That's the point. We match pouch film, laminate thickness, seal width and label size to the machine so your first production day isn't a trial-and-error day.

**What about after-sales support?**
Warranty terms and service response are confirmed in writing by the manufacturer in your quote. We stay on the thread if anything needs escalating.

### https://packworkz.com/circular

**Who can sell scrap through Packworkz?**
Packaging converters, printers, brand factories and warehouses generating regular production scrap. We focus on clean, identified industrial scrap rather than mixed household waste.

**Which materials pay best?**
Clean, single-polymer streams — PE film, BOPP, PET, HDPE and corrugated. Multilayer and metallised laminates are accepted by specialist buyers at lower rates.

**What is the minimum quantity?**
Usually a few hundred kilos per pickup. Smaller regular volumes can be pooled into scheduled monthly pickups.

**Do I get documentation?**
Every load comes with a weighbridge slip and the recycler’s receipt. Where applicable, recyclers share documentation that supports your EPR reporting.

**Can I buy recycled packaging too?**
Yes — our sustainable range includes recycled-content and compostable formats, so the loop closes on your own shelves.

### https://packworkz.com/manufacturing

**Is it free to find a manufacturer?**
Yes. Direct Connect is free for brands and manufacturers. Packworkz takes no commission and does not mark up the factory quote. Launch Desk is an optional one-time paid service if you want us to manage the shortlist, quotes and samples.

**Are these manufacturers verified?**
Only profiles marked Verified have passed Packworkz checks. Profiles marked Unclaimed are compiled from the manufacturer's own public website and haven't been reviewed by us yet — always confirm licences, capacity and pricing before you commit.

**How is this different from a B2B directory?**
You don't pay to unlock phone numbers and your details aren't sold to dozens of sellers. You describe one requirement, we rank factories by capability fit and introduce you to the few that fit.

**I run a factory. How do I get listed?**
List your factory for free. Basic checks (GST, licences) are free and online; the Verified badge adds a video factory walkthrough and capacity review for a one-time fee.

**Can Packworkz supply packaging for my product?**
Yes — that's the point. Once your manufacturer is fixed, we supply the pouches, rollstock, jars, bottles, cartons and labels to their line.
